purpose: Bind opinions, inspectable evidence, a bounded director decision, and the later observed result for a formal video cut. This is a record and validator contract, not a scheduler, router, provider call, or delivery approval.

realm_boundary.free_zone_research: May explore scripts, prompts, visual hypotheses, experiments, failures and candidate media. Its outputs are not formal shots, delivery candidates, or approval evidence by default.
realm_boundary.controlled_video_production: Uses only admitted assets and a formal shot contract. Every provider call, retry, selected take, edit and review must remain traceable to the production record.
realm_boundary.bridge_rule: A Free Zone artifact may enter controlled production only as source_realm=FREE_ZONE_CANDIDATE with an admission object that binds the candidate path/hash, names the accepting formal contract, and records ACCEPTED or REJECTED. No implicit promotion is allowed.
forbidden: Treating a research render as a formal take
Treating a research opinion as DELIVERY_APPROVED
Copying a Free Zone candidate into a final cut without hash-bound admission

admission.free_zone_candidate_rule: source_realm=FREE_ZONE_CANDIDATE requires admission.status=ACCEPTED, candidate_path, candidate_sha256, and accepting_contract_ref.
admission.rejected_rule: REJECTED candidates may remain research evidence but cannot be referenced by a PASS decision.

evidence.rule: Each path must exist beneath the declared project root and its SHA-256 must match. An opinion is not evidence by itself.

roles.utility: Low-cost structure, cataloguing, subtitle or receipt work.
roles.director: Story, action beats, camera and continuity proposal.
roles.challenger: Independent counterexample search; it must name defects rather than agree generically.
roles.final_decider: Synthesizes evidence and disagreements; never supplies an unsupported sole opinion.

opinions.rule: Every evidence_refs entry must resolve to an evidence_id. UNKNOWN is required where the source packet cannot establish a claim.

decision.pass_rule: PASS requires at least one inspectable media/integrity evidence item and no opinion with verdict BLOCKED. PASS is not DELIVERY_APPROVED.
decision.rework_rule: REWORK must name a bounded repair_scope and an expected_gain; it cannot request a whole-episode rerun without a scope explanation.
decision.final_decider_rule: decider_opinion_id must refer to an opinion whose role is final_decider and whose evidence_refs overlap basis_evidence_refs.

result.rule: A decision becomes experience only after RESULT_RECORDED and observed evidence exists. A failed or inconclusive result remains evidence; it must not be discarded.

non_authority: No Decision Record may submit a video task.
No Decision Record may override deterministic preflight, hash, subtitle, audio, or delivery gates.
No Decision Record may claim visual quality from model opinion without artifact evidence.
No Decision Record creates a second scheduler or automatic retry loop.
